title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: chat panel opens by default in Gallery view
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap and Microsoft Learn support the default behaviour, release details, licensing comparison and portal prerequisites. The portal route reaches device settings, and the briefing correctly distinguishes that documented route from the Android setting label and automation that remain undocumented.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the chat panel opening by default in Gallery view on Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join.

claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android chat panel default license meter charge Pro Basic. Read the roadmap record, June 2026 Android release entry and rooms-licensing; no additional licence for changing the panel default is named.

claims.claim: The feature's release note names no separate meter for the default-panel change.

claims.claim: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Rooms > device > Settings reaches a device's settings page.
claims.quote:
Go to Rooms/ Phones in the left navigation and click the device you want to configure.
Select the Settings tab in the device panel.

claims.claim: Portal configuration of Teams Rooms on Android settings requires Rooms Management RBAC permissions.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones), provided you have the necessary role-based access control permissions for Rooms Management.

claims.claim: Portal settings management requires a signed-in device.
claims.quote: Settings management is available only for signed-in devices.

claims.claim: Portal management of settings for the June 2026 release requires Teams Admin Agent 1.0.0.202606082157 or greater.
claims.quote: To enable this functionality, ensure devices are running Teams Admin Agent 1.0.0.202606082157 or greater.

claims.claim: The June 2026 release notes direct management of settings for this release to the Teams Rooms Pro management portal.
claims.quote: Management of settings related to features in this release and future releases is only available within the Teams Rooms Pro management portal

claims.claim: Teams Android devices have a local device administrator account for access to device settings.
claims.quote:
Local device administrator account
Teams Android devices include an administrative account to access device settings, the local web server (if installed), and any OEM specific settings.

claims.claim: Initial credentials for the local administrator account can be obtained from the device manufacturer.
claims.quote: Initial device setup and configuration items such as the default username and password for this account can be obtained from the device manufacturer.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented the exact local Android chat-default setting label and route in the checked material.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "Android" "chat" "setting" "default" "label". Read rooms-release-note?tabs=Android and device-settings-available; the release names a local setting without its label or route and the Android list does not supply them.
